description: This Java class 'FileBasedConfigSupplier' provides functionality for loading configuration data based on a file, with support for environment variable-based file location, resource-based loading, and integration with other configuration sources. It is part of a utility package for managing configurations in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: FileBasedConfigSupplier
classes.description: A final class that supplies a Config object based on a config file, supporting environment variable and resource-based configuration.

methods.name: forConfiguredConfigFile
methods.description: Factory method that creates an instance of FileBasedConfigSupplier based on a file location specified by an environment variable.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Factory method that creates an instance of FileBasedConfigSupplier based on a resource name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the configuration object, integrating possible external content such as VCAP services and secrets.
